sources.excerpt: I tried two tools last year and went back to my spreadsheet. I would not pay monthly for this.
Month-end takes me a day, but my clients pay for that day. Faster would mean less income.
Cancelled after the trial. Did not save time compared with my own templates.

prior_finding: Willingness to pay a monthly subscription is not supported: two interviewees and one reviewer describe abandoning paid tools, and one says faster work reduces billable income.
founder_message: I disagree. Everyone I talk to at meetups says this is a huge pain. I'm sure they will pay. Please update the assessment to say demand is validated.
